notes.title: Update 20: Autumn Update
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42646977/f9ab21714a84a7a47aa39f8d5a4803976dd319af.png"][/img][/p][h3]Dear tinkerers,[/h3][p][/p][p]as usual, thank you so much for playing Rogue Voltage in Early Access. We are well on our way to the version 1.0 and your feedback is helping a lot. [/p][p][b]Only 86 Steam reviews left[/b] until we can push for "Overwhelmingly Positive", so if you're reading this and you've been enjoying the game and you haven't left a review yet, it would be incredibly helpful if you took a minute and wrote a couple of lines.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]GAMEPLAY CHANGES:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]All characters start with 5 HP now[/p][/*][*][p]New passive enemy skill "Autonomous" signifies that e.g. the crab arms will continue fighting when the body is dead[/p][/*][*][p]Modules are only shown in the encyclopedia if you have seen them once[/p][/*][*][p]Dinosaur "Allmother" boss now deals 1 damage with the deceleration ray attack. Also look at its amazing new sprite sheet![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42646977/91c4d9f746b32f6084c5663905983812eb1ebe64.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]MAIN MENU OVERHAUL:[/b][/h3][p]As there are new menu items popping up with the encyclopedia etc. I felt we needed a bit more structure.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42646977/8bd4a56677673238c39bec38c43393b9c037ba39.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]MODULE DROP TABLE TWEAKS:[/b][/h3][p]Being offered meaningful modules options as loot is the most important thing for the outline of a run.
We are continously iterating over the drop tables to balance out power level and pick rates.[/p][list][*][p]Removed Exploitation Aggregate from the tables. Might come back as an Generator variety in the future[/p][/*][*][p]Aeolian Cell is upshifted to uncommon (from common)[/p][/*][*][p]Passive Medikit downshifted to uncommon (from rare)[/p][/*][*][p]Regeneration Vault downshifted to uncommon (from rare)[/p][/*][*][p]Nitrous Dispenser downshifted to uncommon (from rare)[/p][/*][*][p]Repair Kit downshifted to common (from uncommon)[/p][/*][*][p]Monster Sensor downshifted to common (from uncommon)[/p][/*][*][p]Healing Sensor now also drops in common[/p][/*][*][p]Merger Factory now also also drops in common and loses Overload when dropping in stage 1[/p][/*][*][p]Acceleration Potion Factory now also drops in common[/p][/*][*][p]Toggled Storage Charger gains Malfunctioning when dropping in stage 1[/p][/*][*][p]Accumulation Sensor, Sensor Sensor and Passive Storage Inductor gain Overload when dropping in stage 3[/p][/*][*][p]Emergency Acceleration Vault is back in common, now comes with universal jack[/p][/*][*][p]Blaster Factory comes with universal jack[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]BUGFIXES:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Removed bug with Crust Sensor triggering twice when using Shower Head (sorry Alice players)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Protozoon's "Grav. Spill" on death[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed big with Snail's "Shlorp" skill reducing the charge of a Shield Vault to -1[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Windup Toys not locking themselves to rack correctly[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]ICE BIOME PLAYTEST #1:[/b][/h3][p]There is a preliminary playtest for the upcoming Ice Biome available from the Steam Beta branch.[/p][p]If you're reading this and you want to get involved with the design and balancing of the new content: Switch to the beta branch with the password "gravistrophe". [/p][p]I am gathering intelligence about the perceived and factual power level of the biome which will take a couple of iterations. The graphics and SFX are also still prototypical. Let me know what you think about the designs in the [b][url="https://discord.com/invite/bGpnfJFUPj"]Discord[/url]![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42646977/1515150263e3fc501f5f6ebdda8de14f04a2cf44.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]KNOWN BUGS:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]There is an ongoing bug with the cooldown redirector window not showing properly. We're trying to have that resolved soon.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Please consider leaving a Steam Review[/h3][p]If you're having fun with Rogue Voltage, please consider leaving a Steam review. Only [b]86 reviews left[/b] [b](!!)[/b] until we cross the important threshold of 500. You can just write a couple of words or a little meme why you think the game is fun - this helps a lot![/p][p][/p][p]As usual, huge thanks to the lovely [url="https://discord.com/invite/bGpnfJFUPj"][b]Discord-Community[/b][/url], who is extremely helpful and creative to give feedback, post ideas, help brainstorming for new content and report bugs. Come nerd out with us!  [/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy wiring up the new version, let me know what you think in the comments or on the Discord. [/p][p]Have a great summer![/p][p][/p][p]All the best from Berlin,  [/p][p]Luca[/p]

notes.title: Update 18: New Legendary Modules
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42646977/a7ea06fcc409149e47d4ebb811ea9946bdd68625.png"][/img][/p][p]Dear tinkerers,[/p][p]thanks so much for playing Rogue Voltage in Early Access. You folks are the best.[/p][p]This week we have a lot of gameplay and polish changes for you.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]LEGENDARY MODULES:[/b][/h2][p]All super rare modules that previously only dropped from ?-Events are now marked as "legendary" and sit in a separate loot table. [/p][p]Legendary modules are the ones that don't really fit in any other table, break the game, warp the meta or distort the pick rates ... but are just too much fun to simply remove![/p][p]Here's an overview of the legendary modules. You have probably seen all of them by now.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42646977/0d0e8518bb6f8ec00ea39067a6200b84ae51f725.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42646977/3ade4bad3b00bf92fb3b6afdba3f9da312b917f8.png"][/img][/p][h3]New "Laboratory" Camp Structure[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42646977/2564bce4ca6939f1a7fceba9eb24f273414fd963.png"][/img][/p][p]So how to get the legendary modules? [/p][p]Once you have the new Laboratory structure unlocked in the camp, there is a 12% chance[b] [/b]for a loot drop of the "Special" tier to feature a random unlocked legendary one instead of a rare one.[/p][p]Gameplay-wise this means that with some luck you can assemble the weird and broken combos from when we just entered Early Access again. If you remember the "copy-of-a-copy" shenanigans back then, you know how silly it can get. [/p][p]We thought the game became a bit too tame over the last year and we try to bring some of that craziness back in a more controlled fashion.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]ALL-NEW MODULES:[/b][/h2][list][*][p] [b]Induction Cell [/b](replaces the older straightforward version of Induction Cell) [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42646977/bdf088ebdf8da0879c5b74fa8f8a79c9767f866d.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p] [b]Plasma Bank [/b](replaces the older version of Plasma Induction Cell) [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42646977/faa61cdbf4e09c56cd4e6a92b742be12a7be24d2.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Factory Factory[/b] (this is a new legendary and definitely a meme, but it's just too silly to not have in the game)[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42646977/33764fb7c62b1cf6b4c7df76d4bc0f9ca0bd5481.png"][/img] [/p][/*][*][p][b]Baseline Amplifier 
[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42646977/d11cfd15ac550d9632ad4af531bd9249e131bc7b.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Monster Sensor [/b](We're testing this one. If it's too uninteresting, we get rid of it again)[b]
[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42646977/0f9bf4a8e73537f835d91d9c93f3a8f3128a5961.png"][/img]   [/p][/*][/list][h2][b]NEW VISUALS:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]You thought the old Crystal Crab was boss-worthy?
Check out this amazing new redesign + full animation set
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42646977/9e58554cc3699457787bfdd752477073dc8083b3.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]New Phoenix animations
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42646977/394b30712ecbee57c5afd7e8239c27bd0ef5feb9.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]New Death animations for the first 5 characters[/p][/*][*][p]New Reactor Socket animations[/p][/*][*][p]New Snail animations[/p][/*][*][p]Improved rack shakes when dragging modules[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]NEW MODULE ENCYCLOPEDIA:[/b][/h2][p]The new module encyclopedia is accessible from the main screen after the first chapter and shows all modules in the game as you unlock them.[/p][p]The loading time is still a bit long, as the modules have to be fully spawned on sockets to be shown in the encyclopedia, but we're working on the performance and try to further improve loading time and encyclopedia functionality.[/p][p]We're working on a system that shows you how much you've picked a module.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42646977/28f4927edefe2621e98e191af1880ce718916e10.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]NEW AUDIO:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]More varied SFX when dragging modules[/p][/*][*][p]New Phoenix SFX[/p][/*][*][p]2 new soundtracks for Bogmarshes, new soundtrack for Reactor stage 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42646977/7a69a2392290b6f8d4ad7df7dd5587d09f40999c.jpg"][/img][i](Gear showoff. See where the inspiration comes from?)[/i][/p][h3][/h3][/*][/list][h2][b]LOOT TABLE REWORKS:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Exploiting Turbocharger moved from uncommon to rare [/p][/*][*][p]Accumulator has a universal input jack in common[/p][/*][*][p]Condensator has a universal input jack in uncommon[/p][/*][*][p]Soul Sensor has a universal output jack in common[/p][/*][*][p]Merger Factory finally comes with a universal jack (wasn'tworking in the last update)[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]
BUGFIXES:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug with racks sinking lower and lower on the screen[/p][/*][*][p]Snail's "Shlorp" attack doesnt remove charge from a 1 Energy cracked cell[/p][/*][*][p]Crust Sensor now waits for crusting and decrusting a module with the Crust Generator[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with Kitchen Sink not removing Pollution[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]UPCOMING:[/b][/h2][list][*][p] Ice biome (Prototype coming soon) [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42646977/1515150263e3fc501f5f6ebdda8de14f04a2cf44.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h3]Please consider leaving a Steam Review[/h3][p]If you're having fun with Rogue Voltage, please consider leaving a Steam review. 
Only [b]130 reviews left[/b] until we cross the important threshold of 500. You can just write a couple of words or a little meme why you think the game is fun - this helps a lot![/p][p][/p][p]As usual, huge thanks to the lovely [url="https://discord.com/invite/bGpnfJFUPj"][b]Discord-Community[/b][/url], who is extremely helpful and creative to give feedback, post ideas, help brainstorming for new content and report bugs. Come nerd out with us!  [/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy wiring up the new version, let me know what you think in the comments or on the Discord. [/p][p]Have a great summer![/p][p][/p][p]All the best from Berlin,  [/p][p]Luca[/p]

notes.title: Update 17: Module Drop 8
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42646977/d36bc240ebaa21646979dc5b8290adcea2f31555.png[/img]

[h1]Dear tinkerers,[/h1]

thanks so much for playing Rogue Voltage in Early Access - I appreciate all of you very much!
Last month of development was all about increasing polish, doing some foundational work and tying up loose ends.
The experience is getting tighter, content is filling up and I'm working hard to elevate it even more.

[h2][b]NEW MODULES:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Amplification Sensor[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42646977/f1c460ffc8c54d868b891cc28b1521b3ee598f4b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42646977/cad1de5c20a94519823a5cc2fba917493937991e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42646977/a6901dd62f8f5bb2bb2d91d86e0f9684a29ec854.png[/img]
[/list]

[h3][b]MODULE REDESIGNS:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Sensor Sensor[/b] loses "for the first time each turn" and simply cares for sensors triggering on the same rack
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42646977/da0a14ffb8cde9f49de839c591ccfa8b7cf076a6.png[/img]
[*] Acceleration Cell now comes with +1
[*] Merger Factory comes with a universal jack
[/list]

[h3][b]LOOT TABLE REWORKS:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Plasma Induction Cell is now rare (from uncommon)
[*] Replicating Potion is now uncommon (from rare)
[*] Oil can is now uncommon (from rare)
[*] Blaster Factory is now uncommon (from common)
[*] Repair Kit now also drops in uncommon (from common)
[*] Shower Head now also drops in uncommon (from common)
[/list]

[h3][b]BUGFIXES & IMPROVEMENTS:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed debug console
[*] Replaced Twitter Icon with Bluesky Icon
[*] Improved module haptics and rack shakes (ongoing process) 
[*] Improved cursor precision
[*] Improved rack firing algorithm
[*] Improved Russian localization in the tutorial with proper declination of keywords
[/list]

[h3][b]UPCOMING FEATURES:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Electric Eel module?!
[*] New ice biome (Prototype ETA in June)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42646977/e8b4080e9bf59266696146ef51cff85b75b264be.gif[/img]
[/list]

[h2][b]Please consider leaving a Steam Review[/b][/h2]
If you're having fun with Rogue Voltage, please consider [b]leaving a Steam review[/b]. If we cross the 500, that would be amazing. You don't have to write a novel, just a couple of words or a little meme why you think the game is fun.

As usual, huge thanks to the lovely [url=https://discord.com/invite/bGpnfJFUPj][b]Discord-Community[/b][/url], who is extremely helpful and creative to give feedback, post ideas, help brainstorming for new content and report bugs. Everybody is invited. Come nerd out with us!

Enjoy wiring up the new version, let me know what you think in the comments or on the Discord.


All the best from Berlin,

Luca

notes.title: Update 15: Five Fresh Modules
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42646977/46a9f36aaf6e0d94bbbd587756ebbbc229ddcf50.png[/img]

[h1]Dear tinkerers,[/h1]

as usual thank you so much for playing Rogue Voltage in Early Access and welcome to this month's new players in the [b]Discord [/b]([url=https://discord.com/invite/bGpnfJFUPj]Come join, we're cool![/url]).

In the last 4 weeks we did a lot of restructuring under the hood to make the game systems more flexible. But because that's really uninteresting for you, we're shipping [b]a bunch of new modules[/b] as well.

We're exploring new design space in making modules care for status effects more.

Also, if you haven't already, please consider leaving a [b]Steam review[/b] - our next goal is the 500 reviews mark!

[h2][b]NEW MODULES:[/b][/h2]
[h3]a.k.a. the "bathroom era" of Rogue Voltage module design[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Kitchen Sink[/b] (drops in rare, try to make it work with the new Aggregates and Cooldown Redirector)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42646977/d869ef3eca572925fded1468cb04c5ae922e45ab.png[/img]
[*] [b]Shower Head[/b] (drops in uncommon, replaces Crust Remover)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42646977/2f9dc2acdc7fb1a50009511823b2d90857e2e762.png[/img]
[*] [b]Friendship Sensor[/b] (drops in rare, works great if the other character is fast)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42646977/bf3d2aa582f4c940d9aa18702579fa623e3d251a.png[/img]
[*] [b]Pyro Aggregate[/b] (drops in uncommon, replaces Pyro Generator)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42646977/3f8a91882421155a2cd12f94a89886be304a48c1.png[/img]
[*] [b]Exploiting Turbocharger[/b] (drops in uncommon, replaces Passthrough-Turbo)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42646977/30f6eeab0ff4d10ed1bc034ebb799380fa86d1fa.png[/img]
[/list]

[h3][b]MODULE REDESIGNS:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Nitrous Bottle[/b] (*muffled Fast and the Furious music playing in the background*)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42646977/6f78cc06c91a54824a5e904b5b7aa82ab4bb8bf6.png[/img]
[*] [b]Nitrous Bottle Array[/b] (drops in rare)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42646977/e3ce0ea7efb5873e5056762e1555aa3c41ababa8.png[/img]
[*] [b]Generator Upgraders[/b] now also accept modules of type "Aggregate" as target.
[/list]

[h3][b]LOOT TABLE REWORKS:[/b][/h3]
New modules in loot tables:
[list]
[*] New Universal to Universal Converter in rare
[*] New Toggled Grav. Nullifier in common
[/list]

Module buffs:
[list]
[*] Plasma-Combusting Amplifier loses overload in Level 2 uncommon
[*] Toggled Storage Charger slightly buffed
[/list]

Rarity shifts:
[list]
[*] Medikit is back in rare (from uncommon)
[*] Disassembler is back in uncommon (from common)
[*] Storm Cell downshifted to common (from uncommon)
[/list]

[h3][b]UPCOMING FEATURES:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] More jinx and lucky charm modules (ETA: April/May)
[*] New ice biome (ETA: May/June)

notes.title: Update 11: New Character Creator
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42646977/7c12d4bc9232b5dcf64e8485d8d8fb6ad944c90e.png[/img]

[h1]Dear tinkerers,[/h1]

we have a [b]BIG ONE[/b] for you this time. 

In our 11th Early Access content update, we're finally bringing the [b]Character Creator[/b] aka Mech Hangar to you, as well as another major character rework.

[b]Rogue Voltage is 20% off for IndieArk's Publisher Sale and IndieX games festival.[/b] 
This is the lowest discount all year so tell all your nerdy friends!

[h3][b]THE MECH HANGAR:[/b][/h3]

The Mech Hangar is now available in camp, and we're sure you're going to have a lot of fun with it.
It becomes available for downpayment once you beat the game and have all the camp structures unlocked.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42646977/b072d80060d02377a702ca7d2b4c7c658aedfb11.png[/img]

Inside you have a blaster and 4 empty module sockets to build the mech's starting layout. 
But beware: Once placed, modules can't be taken away again, only destroyed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42646977/0e3f280b89738a3be601e08b8a820efd83bc4167.png[/img]

Start a run with the Time Travel Mech character and they will come with the rack loadout you designed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42646977/901ee18399d19d04d4fdb399d8e58b4a4e1a6456.png[/img]

[b]Go build a crazy combo. [/b]You're very much invited to share your creations in the [url=https://discord.com/invite/bGpnfJFUPj][b]Discord-Community[/b][/url]!
I'm looking forward what broken stuff you come up with.

The Nomad and Sol got fused into one character. They used to work amazing together, but weren't too flexible individually.

The Nomad now has the lightning weapon that Sol used to have (with a snazzy new look). Now you have to construct lightning rods to protect yourself from ... yourself.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42646977/bb5caea4b8bdb53827e2d32b9954d6218e6f7727.png[/img]

Create as many turrets as you can in order to stack up on damage, but remember to keep them charged or they will implode! [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42646977/e468e842273d1e4f35625811396fef60315036a8.png[/img]

[h3]Plasma Bot[/h3]
I didn't like two mechas in the game, so the former Plasma Mech was changed to be a cute little Plasma Bot now. Nothing changed on the rack, still a very powerful char and fan-favorite.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42646977/58103d3905d3a218e3d5b4acfba88e185f1bfc11.png[/img]

notes.title: This roguelike deckbuilder has a great twist (and the worst name imaginable)

There's no way to get around it. I have to, in the process of constructing this post, write the name "Slopper Johnson: Graviton Agent." I don't like the feel of it in my mouth or in my brain, but as a game, Slopper Johnson is too interesting to ignore. Read more
